notes: PARTIAL: NCDMV's catalog is a JS ordering app and NCDMV posted no plate news releases I could find, so this comes from the statute (G.S. 20-79.4) and session laws since 2023. Venus Flytrap and NCSSM were both authorized by S.L. 2024-30 (effective July 1, 2024); Venus Flytrap is confirmed on sale, while NCSSM is unconfirmed (a 2025 fix to its letter format suggests it is being issued). Not yet issued: 'Lifetime Conservationist' (S.L. 2026-43, effective Oct 1, 2026) and an 'America's Semiquincentennial' standard-plate background (S.L. 2026-58). Surfrider and Battleship North Carolina are still collecting pre-orders and are not authorized. NCDMV's inactive-plates PDF lists 135 authorized plates that never reached production, which explains most of the statute plates missing from the game. No retirements of game plates confirmed; the NASCAR driver 'Limited Inventory' plates could not be checked.
